**Several cheaper alternatives to Blackbaud exist for nonprofits, particularly for donor management and fundraising, with entry-level pricing starting as low as $19–$45 per month.** These options often provide core CRM features like donor tracking, email campaigns, and reporting at a fraction of Blackbaud's cost, which typically starts higher (e.g., eTapestry at $100–$150/month).[1][3]

### Top Cheapest Alternatives by Starting Price
| Alternative | Starting Price | Best For | Key Features | Citation |
|-------------|----------------|----------|--------------|----------|
| **Donately** | $19/month (Starter) | Small organizations | Fundraising platform with low fees (3.5%), scalable plans | [1] |
| **Copper** | $19/month (standard) | G Suite users, small teams | CRM with Google integration, custom fields, pipelines; 14-day free trial | [1] |
| **Insightly** | $29/month | General nonprofits | CRM testing with free trials for Plus/Professional plans | [1] |
| **Sumac** | $35/month (paid); free plan available | Nonprofits needing basics | Donor management; upgrade for advanced features | [1] |
| **Little Green Light** | $39–$45/month | Small nonprofits, eTapestry users | Essential donor tools, peer support; fraction of Blackbaud cost | [1][3][7] |
| **DonorSnap** | $39/month (up to 1,000 contacts) | Small orgs | All features included, scales to $199 for 30,000 contacts | [1] |
| **Kindful** | From $33/month | Integrated fundraising | Cost reduction from eTapestry; donor management | [3][7] |
| **NeonCRM** | $49–$99/month | Mid-sized orgs | Robust donor CRM, built-in email | [1][3] |
| **Bloomerang** | $40–$125/month (varies by records) | Donor retention, small shops | User-friendly, engagement scoring; free trial/demo | [1][3][4][7] |
| **DonorPerfect** | $89–$99/month | Mid-size teams | Constituent management, online fundraising; unlimited users | [1][3][4] |

### Key Considerations
- **For smallest budgets**: Opt for free/open-source like **CiviCRM** (free) or Sumac's free plan, or low-entry like Copper/Donately under $20/month.[1][3]
- **Scalability**: Most scale by contacts/records (e.g., Bloomerang at $99 for 1,000 records), avoiding Blackbaud's enterprise complexity.[1][4]
- **Specialized needs**: Churches may prefer Tithe.ly ($72/month) or ACS; grant management users consider Optimy or Submittable (mid-range pricing).[5][6][7]
- Limitations: Cheaper options may lack Blackbaud's advanced enterprise features (e.g., for large museums via Altru), so evaluate based on organization size and needs. Many offer free trials/demos.[1][3][7]
